features.name: Franklin Square Fountain and SquareBurger
features.description: The restored 1838 Franklin Square Fountain and nearby SquareBurger form the park's central gathering area, with free viewing but separate show and food-service schedules.
features.source_label: Historic Philadelphia Franklin Square visit guide

features.name: Parx Liberty Carousel
features.description: Parx Liberty Carousel is Franklin Square's gentle, ticketed family ride with Philadelphia-themed animals, separate operating hours and a rider-height supervision rule.
features.source_label: Historic Philadelphia Franklin Square visit guide

details.informationSourceLabel: Historic Philadelphia Franklin Square visit guide
details.imageAlt: Parx Liberty Carousel at Franklin Square

features.name: Philly Mini Golf
features.description: Philly Mini Golf is Franklin Square's 18-hole outdoor course built around miniature Philadelphia landmarks, with timed capacity, separate tickets and weather-sensitive play.

details.imageAlt: Philly Mini Golf at Franklin Square

features.name: Franklin Square PATCO Station
features.description: Franklin Square PATCO Station reopened in 2025 beside the park, restoring direct rail access between Center City, Camden County and the square.

details.imageAlt: Franklin Square PATCO Station at Franklin Square
